Pompeii.

Throughout the city, drinking water was made available at constructed springs set by the street sides. A simple square of stone with a fountain in the middle.

The only way to drink was to balance your weight with your left hand while craning your head under the flow of water. Hard to describe but basically every person who ever used that fountain did it the same way.

The stone had been worn away by the passing of thousands of hands across hundreds of years.

So I bent like all the people before me, put my hand in that spot, and drank.

It was an incredible connection to the past. If a simple one. Pompeii is mind blowing. With a good tour guide you really begin to see how they lived and how they were people just like us.
